data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements 'geweorc' meaning 'spear' and 'gisil' meaning 'pledge, hostage'. The name Jörg is a variant of the name George. The name Jörg carries the meaning “George” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Jörg usually hope their child will grow to embody george and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jörg total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_greek.name: Γεώργιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Γεώργιος προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Γεωργός, που σημαίνει 'εργάτης του εδάφους' ή 'αγρότης'. Το όνομα συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Γεώργιο, έναν από τους πιο δημοφιλείς αγίους της Χριστιανικής Ορθοδοξίας, που ήταν γνωστός για την πίστη και το θάρρος του.

in_latin.name: Georgius
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Georgius originem habet in latino nomine Georgicus, quod significat 'agricola' vel 'terrae cultor'. Hoc nomen ad Sanctum Georgium refertur, qui fuit unus de sanctis patronis Christianorum, notus propter fidem et fortitudinem suam.

in_english.name: Jörg
in_english.meaning: farmer or earthworker, derived from Greek
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jörg is of Germanic origin, derived from the Greek name Georgios (Γεώργιος), meaning 'farmer' or 'earthworker'. It is associated with Saint George, a prominent Christian martyr and patron saint of various countries. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and devotion to faith.
